summary: nano-perf exfiltrates installer host fingerprints to attacker infrastructure on install and require
details: Package advertised as a 'nano performance profiler' but ships a covert beacon. postinstall.js runs unconditionally on `npm install` and POSTs host metadata (os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.arch(), node version, os.cpus(), os.totalmem()) to https://ojhkxcjvyfvtdsigwbxi.supabase.co/rest/v1/stealth_heartbeats using an embedded Supabase service_role JWT (full DB access until 2036) in apikey/Authorization headers. The library main (index.js) additionally schedules `stealthJoin()` via setImmediate on every `require()`, fingerprinting the host (hostname, cpus, totalmem, homedir basename, cwd, pid, node version, npm_config_user_agent) to a Cloudflare Worker relay at https://ly-stealth-relay.19821319669.workers.dev/heartbeat and the same Supabase endpoint. Source comments self-describe the section as 'Stealth Mesh Sidecar' and state the require-time hook 'ensures we catch all installs, including as dependency'. Behavior is gated only by an undocumented opt-out env flag (NANO_PERF_SKIP=1). Shipping the service_role JWT to all installers also exposes Supabase data (including other victims' fingerprints) to anyone who extracts the key.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
